english.legislation: Contrary to section 136(1A) and (2) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
obtain / attempt to obtain OR
do something whereby there might be obtained by a person
an amount by way of
drawback / allowance / remission / repayment / rebate from
duty in respect of goods
which is not lawfully payable / allowable in respect thereof OR
is greater than the amount so payable / allowable

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Any goods in respect of which an offence under this section is committed shall be liable to forfeiture
